Method of Attack: Delivered through a Microsoft Word document with a macro extracting a DLL downloader
Extracts and executes payloads including a dropper (tpd1.exe) and main payload (TermSrvClt.dll)
Establishes persistence via LNK file in Windows Startup folder
Exfiltrates system information using systeminfo.exe and tasklist.exe
Downloads and launches final unknown payload
Impacted Systems: Potentially organizations in the United States
Attack Vector: Spear-phishing via malicious Microsoft Word document with macro
Spoofed invitation to international scientific event
Indicators of Compromise: Persistence via LNK file in Windows Startup folder
